summary: Ran backend + frontend regression checks for chat delivery/read tick changes and translation endpoint. Backend pytest passed (4/4), web/mobile preview loaded, and /chat/testconversation1 now shows graceful unavailable state (no red overlay). Real two-device delivery-vs-read verification remains blocked by required signed-in live accounts/devices.

integration_issues.flow: Realtime delivery ticks (single tick -> double tick without opening chat)
integration_issues.issue: Could not be fully validated in this environment because it requires two real signed-in devices/accounts receiving live pushes.

markDelivered calls are wrapped in broad catch blocks and use any-typed api path ((api as any).messages.markDelivered), so missing/failed backend function can silently no-op at runtime and keep ticks stale.

action_items: Run real-device auth test with two users: sender sends message while receiver app is foregrounded but not inside that conversation; confirm deliveredTo updates and sender tick turns double (not blue).
Verify read transition separately: when receiver opens the conversation, confirm readBy updates and sender tick turns blue.
Add stronger telemetry/error reporting around markDelivered failures (currently mostly swallowed) so production issues are diagnosable.
Confirm Convex backend exposes messages.markDelivered for the authenticated role used by mobile clients.
critical_code_review_comments: Requested frontend hooks are present: usePushNotifications receives message notifications and calls messages.markDelivered; chat screen separately calls markDelivered and markRead.
Tick rendering logic appears updated correctly in both MediaBubble and inline MessageBubble: readBy.length > 0 drives blue/read, deliveredTo drives delivered state.
Both chat and call route files remain very large (>700 lines), increasing regression risk around side effects and realtime state handling.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ status row via backend test_status_create_and_persisted_get
context_for_next_testing_agent: Baseline routes are stable in preview (boot + chat fallback). Remaining blocker is authenticated realtime validation across two live devices/accounts for delivery vs read receipts and push-triggered markDelivered behavior.
rca_of_issue: Most plausible RCA for persistent one-tick symptom if still seen on devices: markDelivered mutation may fail/no-op (missing backend function, auth denial, or runtime mutation error) and current frontend catches suppress hard failure visibility. Repro target: sender sends to receiver online in app but outside chat -> if deliveredTo not updated until chat open, markDelivered-on-notification path is not effectively persisting delivery. MOCKED APIs: NONE.
